cues.en: Let me tell you about a place

cues.zh: 它远在郊区城市化扩张的边界之外，

cues.en: where success and failure collide,
cues.zh: 成功与失败在这里碰撞，

cues.en: and where utopia and the apocalypse
cues.zh: 乌托邦与世界末日

cues.en: meet to dance a dirty tango.
cues.zh: 在这里相遇，跳起一曲肮脏的探戈。

cues.en: It's a special place,
cues.zh: 这是一个特殊的地方，

cues.en: a bit closer than you might think,
cues.zh: 比你想象的还要近一些，

cues.en: that draws a unique group of outsiders
cues.zh: 它吸引了一群独特的外来者，

cues.en: looking for an awfully beautiful life
cues.zh: 他们在这座美丽得可怕的天堂边缘，

cues.en: on the edge of a beautifully awful paradise.
cues.zh: 追寻着可怕而美丽的生活。

cues.en: You know what? There's very few people that don't know about the Salis Sea.
cues.zh: 你知道吗？几乎没有人不知道索尔顿海。

cues.en: Very few.
cues.zh: 真的没几个人。

cues.en: Because they don't know where it's at. They tell them 50 miles south of Palm Springs.
cues.zh: 因为他们根本不知道它在哪。别人告诉他们就在棕榈泉以南 50 英里。

cues.en: So I use it as a reference point.
cues.zh: 所以我把它当参照点。

cues.zh: 加州的

cues.zh: 法国里维埃拉版本

cues.en: with beautiful weather,
cues.zh: 天气宜人，

cues.en: water available for the boating, as a place for recreation and fishing and so on.
cues.zh: 有水域可以划船，是休闲、钓鱼之类的好去处。

cues.en: Fishing in the summer is great.
cues.zh: 夏天钓鱼很棒。

cues.en: The
cues.zh: 水

cues.zh: 越热，钓鱼越好。

cues.en: That's not edible fish. If they're eating those fish and they eat very much of them, they'll get botulism poisoning.
cues.zh: 那不是能吃的鱼。如果他们吃那些鱼、吃得很多，就会中肉毒杆菌毒。

cues.zh: 那片海很脏。

cues.zh: 死鱼、死鸟，那边什么都有。

cues.en: We have the odor problem, we have the insect problem,
cues.zh: 我们有气味问题，有昆虫问题，

cues.zh: 这里夏天很热。气温能到120度，午夜都有100度，你知道的，很暖和。

cues.en: But that's what we got air conditioning for.
cues.zh: 但这就是我们装空调的原因。

cues.en: We do even go swimming in the water. It's more saltier than the ocean.
cues.zh: 我们甚至还会下水游泳。它比海水还咸。

cues.en: And it
cues.zh: 而且它

cues.en: heals your skin. If you have a skin problem,
cues.zh: 能治愈你的皮肤。如果你有皮肤问题，

cues.zh: 它能治好你的皮肤。为什么要清理一条最有用的下水道？

cues.en: It's the greatest sewer the world has ever seen. Leave it that way. It's perfect for that purpose.
cues.zh: 这是世上最伟大的下水道。就让它保持那样。它完美地胜任这个用途。

cues.en: If it had been handled correctly, it would have been another Palm Springs right now.
cues.zh: 如果处理得当，它现在会是另一个棕榈泉。

cues.en: The smell.
cues.zh: 那股气味。

cues.en: It's the smell of the lot.
cues.zh: 是这片地方的气味。

cues.en: And then the fact that we don't have anything here.
cues.zh: 还有就是这里什么都没有。

cues.en: It is rather bleak.
cues.zh: 确实相当荒凉。

cues.en: Bleak is the word.
cues.zh: 荒凉这个词说得对。

cues.en: The most beautiful body of water in California. You can go boating. You can go fishing. You can go jet skiing, you have beautiful rock formation,
cues.zh: 加州最美的水域。你可以划船。你可以钓鱼。你可以玩水上摩托，有美丽的岩层，

cues.en: you have the mountains where you can see... A on a summertime, you can see the snow caps in the mountain. You have everything.
cues.zh: 有群山，你能看到……夏天，你能看到山上的雪顶。你什么都有。

cues.en: You have everything that you can find nowhere else. There's no fast foods here.
cues.zh: 你能拥有别处找不到的一切。这里没有快餐。

cues.en: There's no
cues.zh: 这里没有

cues.en: no recreation
cues.zh: 没有娱乐设施

cues.en: for youngsters,
cues.zh: 给年轻人、

cues.en: kids, anything. I mean, there ain't nothing here. You can't get nothing. The store's closed at 06:00.
cues.zh: 孩子，什么都没有。我是说，这儿啥都没有。你什么都弄不到。商店六点就关门。

cues.en: So you can't buy booze after another 06:00.
cues.zh: 所以六点以后就买不到酒了。

cues.en: I like it here. I'll die here.
cues.zh: 我喜欢这里。我会死在这里。

cues.en: I mean, come on. We ain't even got a mall or nothing out here. We're away from everything. But it's it's just a super,
cues.zh: 我是说，拜托。我们这儿连个商场什么的都没有。我们远离一切。但它就是，就是超级，

cues.en: super wonderful place.
cues.zh: 超级美妙的地方。

cues.en: Lying well below sea level in one of the hottest and driest valleys on earth
cues.zh: 它远低于海平面，坐落在地球上最炎热、最干燥的山谷之一

cues.en: sits the wonderfully bizarre
cues.zh: 坐落着奇妙又怪异的

cues.en: Salton Sea.
cues.zh: 索尔顿湖。

cues.en: It
cues.zh: 它

cues.en: was once hailed as the fishing capital of the world and even rivaled the nearby resort town of Palm Springs in popularity.
cues.zh: 曾被誉为世界钓鱼之都，人气甚至可与附近的度假小镇棕榈泉媲美。

cues.en: But now, after a string of catastrophes,
cues.zh: 但现在，经历一连串灾难之后，

cues.en: it sits virtually abandoned
cues.zh: 它几乎被废弃，

cues.en: and forgotten.
cues.zh: 并被遗忘。

cues.en: Only a handful of eccentrics remain,
cues.zh: 只有少数怪人还留在这里，

cues.en: carving out their own slice of paradise
cues.zh: 开辟出属于自己的天堂一角，

cues.en: on the shores of the so called ecological
cues.zh: 在所谓的生态

cues.en: disaster.
cues.zh: 灾难的岸边。

cues.en: But disaster is well known to the people of Imperial Valley.
cues.zh: 但帝国谷的人们对灾难并不陌生。

cues.en: In fact, the Sultan Sea itself
cues.zh: 事实上，索尔顿湖本身

cues.en: is just one big mistake.
cues.zh: 就是个大错误。

cues.en: developers with a dream to transform the desert diverted water from the Colorado River to a dried lake bed named the Salton Sink.
cues.zh: 怀揣改造沙漠梦想的开发者们，把科罗拉多河的水引到一个名为索尔顿洼地的干涸湖床。

cues.en: As an ancient overflow for the Colorado River, the soil was nutrient rich, and the warm climate made it possible to grow crops year round.
cues.zh: 作为科罗拉多河古老的溢流区，这里土壤肥沃，温暖的气候让全年种植作物成为可能。

cues.en: Renamed the Imperial Valley,
cues.zh: 改名为帝国谷后，

cues.en: land was sold and farming flourished in the desert.
cues.zh: 土地被出售，农业在沙漠中繁荣起来。

cues.en: However,
cues.zh: 然而，

cues.en: silt eventually blocked the entrance to the canal, and water delivery was all but cut off to the farmers.
cues.zh: 泥沙最终堵住了运河的入口，对农民的供水几乎完全被切断。

cues.en: Under pressure from desperate investors,
cues.zh: 在绝望的投资者施加的压力下，

cues.en: engineers made several unprotected cuts into the river.
cues.zh: 工程师们对这条河进行了几处没有防护的开挖。

cues.en: Then in nineteen o five, amidst heavy spring rains, the erratic Colorado broke free, changed course, and headed straight for the Imperial Valley.
cues.zh: 然后在 1905 年，伴随着春季的大雨，喜怒无常的科罗拉多河挣脱了束缚，改变了流向，直奔帝国谷而去。

cues.en: The river that had once brought prosperity
cues.zh: 这条曾带来繁荣的河流，

cues.en: now began to destroy everything in its path as it began to collect in the lowest point,
cues.zh: 现在开始摧毁其路径上的一切，因为它开始在最低点汇聚，

cues.en: the Sultan Sink.
cues.zh: 即索尔顿盆地。

cues.en: In order to protect a vital shipping route, Southern Pacific Railroad tycoon Edward Harriman
cues.zh: 为了保护一条至关重要的航运路线，南太平洋铁路大亨爱德华·哈里曼

cues.en: intervened with the support of President Theodore Roosevelt to do battle with the river.
cues.zh: 在西奥多·罗斯福总统的支持下介入，与这条河展开了较量。

cues.en: With thousands of men and countless tons of rock and sand, the railroad and the United States government attempted several times to plug the breach.
cues.zh: 铁路公司和美国政府动用了数千名劳动力以及无数吨的岩石和沙子，多次尝试堵住缺口。

cues.en: After tremendous effort and sixteen months of flooding, they finally managed to turn back the river.
cues.zh: 经过巨大的努力和长达十六个月的洪水泛滥，他们终于设法让这条河改道回原位。

cues.en: The desert heat should have quickly evaporated this man made mistake.
cues.zh: 沙漠的高温本该很快蒸发掉这个人为造成的错误。

cues.en: However, salty irrigation runoff from farmers in the Imperial Valley sustained the newly formed sea and increased its salinity to near ocean levels.
cues.zh: 然而，来自帝国谷农民的含盐灌溉退水维持了这个新形成的湖泊，并使其盐度增加到了接近海洋的水平。

cues.en: An engineering screw up had given birth to a sea 35 miles long and 15 miles wide
cues.zh: 一个工程上的失误催生出了一片长 35 英里、宽 15 英里的海洋，

cues.en: in the middle of the desert.
cues.zh: 就位于沙漠的中央。

cues.en: And they thought that the Salton Sea would be good good for fish if they could get the right kind of fish to grow in there. So they went down to San Felipe and
cues.zh: 他们认为，如果能找到合适的鱼类在里面生长，索尔顿湖对养鱼会很有好处。于是他们去了圣费利佩，

cues.en: seen fish out of the surf there.
cues.zh: 看到了那里海浪中的鱼。

cues.en: But they tried to keep all the sharks out there. They didn't wanna put any sharks in here. And they brought the fish up. I met them at Salt Creek up here. They put the fish in right there at Salt Creek. That was 1951 in June.
cues.zh: 但他们试图把所有的鲨鱼都挡在外面。他们可不想把鲨鱼放进这里。然后他们把鱼运了上来。我在上面的盐溪（Salt Creek）迎到了他们。他们就在那里的盐溪把鱼放了进去。那是1951年6月。

cues.en: Finally, in 1957,
cues.zh: 最后，在1957年，

cues.en: we started catching a few corvina at Salt Creek. We caught the first two limits of fish that were ever caught in the Salton Sea. Caught 12 fish there, and they were between eight and ten pounds.
cues.zh: 我们开始在盐溪捕到一些科尔维纳鱼（corvina）。我们捕获了索尔顿湖（Salton Sea）历史上第一批达到限额的鱼。在那里捕到了12条鱼，每条在8到10磅之间。

cues.en: And that started the fishing down here. By 1960,
cues.zh: 这开启了这里的捕鱼业。到了1960年，

cues.en: there were eight boat landings
cues.zh: 湖周围有八个

cues.en: around the sea, launching 50 to a 100 boats a day.
cues.zh: 游艇码头，每天有50到100艘船下水。

cues.en: They were here by the hundreds up and down this highway and we we fed a 100 fishermen a day here during the summertime, you know. If you like to fish, there are plenty in the Salton Sea.
cues.zh: 这条公路沿线到处都是人，你知道的，夏天我们这里每天要接待100名渔民。如果你喜欢钓鱼，索尔顿湖里有的是。

cues.en: So far they've been caught up to 33 pounds.
cues.zh: 目前捕获的鱼体重已达33磅。

cues.en: There are corvina,
cues.zh: 这里有科尔维纳鱼，

cues.en: totoaba,
cues.zh: 加利福尼亚湾石首鱼，

cues.en: and mullet in abundance.
cues.zh: 以及大量的鲻鱼。

cues.en: It's not anything like it used to be. It used to be beautiful.
cues.zh: 这里已经今非昔比了。过去这里美极了。

cues.en: There used to just be trailers and motorhomes
cues.zh: 到处都停满了拖挂房车和房车，

cues.en: and skiers and boaters and swimmers
cues.zh: 到处都是

cues.en: everywhere.
cues.zh: 滑水者、划船者和游泳者。

cues.en: In the sixties
cues.zh: 在20世纪60年代，

cues.en: particularly was really a vibrant sea. You not only had skiing, swimming and such, you had the rich folks coming down Malay with the sport fishing boats,
cues.zh: 这里尤其是一个充满生机的海。不仅有滑水、游泳之类的活动，还有有钱人开着运动钓鱼船来到马来（Malay），

cues.en: putting in, I guess, probably North Shore and doing the sport fishing on the weekends
cues.zh: 我想大概是在北岸（North Shore）下水，在周末进行海钓，

cues.en: and all
cues.zh: 以及各种

cues.en: kinds of nice little secluded
cues.zh: 风景优美的小巧隐秘之所，

cues.en: places for those who wanted to get away from the crowd.
cues.zh: 供那些想要远离人群的人去放松。

cues.en: Swimming and
cues.zh: 游泳、

cues.en: drinking beer
cues.zh: 喝啤酒

cues.en: drinking beer and throwing skimming rocks.
cues.zh: 喝啤酒、打水漂。

cues.en: The water was brackish and it wasn't... It isn't like today. It was it was it was less salty than the ocean at that time. We used to have fish fries. So anybody that caught any brought them up and the corvina and oh, god, they so good.
cues.zh: 那里的水是微咸的，而且不像……不像现在这样。当时那里的盐分比海洋要少。我们过去常办烤鱼派对。谁钓到鱼就会带过来，有短吻银鲛，天哪，味道真好。

cues.en: They cooked them in a beer batter.
cues.zh: 他们用啤酒面糊来炸鱼。

cues.en: Fun, fun, fun.
cues.zh: 好玩，好玩，真好玩。

cues.en: Water means fun and Salton Sea water is ideal for the amateur skier, superb for the skillful. The reason? The low altitude and accompanying density makes Salton Sea one of the fastest bodies of water on earth. In the fifties and sixties,
cues.zh: 水意味着乐趣，而索尔顿海的水对业余滑水者来说是理想之选，对高手来说也堪称绝佳。原因何在？较低的海拔和随之而来的水质密度，使索尔顿海成为地球上速度最快的水域之一。在上世纪五六十年代，

cues.en: the sea took in more... Had more tourists
cues.zh: 这里的游客比……

cues.en: than Yosemite Park.
cues.zh: 优胜美地公园还要多。

cues.en: Down here. We had boat races.
cues.zh: 就在这里。我们曾举办过赛艇比赛。

cues.en: We had everything.
cues.zh: 我们什么都有。

cues.en: We had all kinds of celebrities at the Salton Sea and big events.
cues.zh: 索尔顿海曾迎来各种名流和盛大活动。

cues.en: We had Sonny Bono
cues.zh: 我们接待过索尼·博诺（Sonny Bono），

cues.en: when the Marks Brothers and
cues.zh: 当马克斯兄弟和

cues.en: the Beach Boys used to come out here.
cues.zh: 海滩男孩乐队经常来这里的时候。

cues.en: The yacht clubs on all sides were developing and booming and boats were in and out of the water.
cues.zh: 各处的游艇俱乐部都在发展和繁荣，船只在水中进进出出。

cues.en: Eventually this area was laid out
cues.zh: 最终，这片区域被规划为

cues.en: as a retirement community.
cues.zh: 一个退休社区。

cues.en: They basically laid this out, put in the infrastructure,
cues.zh: 他们基本上是规划好了这里，铺设了基础设施，

cues.en: and then started selling it. Out of the labor and mind of man, out of the barren desert, out of the many months of endeavor and daring imagination,
cues.zh: 然后开始售卖。凭借人类的辛勤劳作与智慧，从荒凉的沙漠中，经过数月的奋斗与大胆的想象，

cues.en: a city is born. And business sees a future in Salton City and becomes part of the great scheme of things. A major oil company becomes a part, a modern rescue.
cues.zh: 一座城市诞生了。企业看到了索尔顿市的未来，并成为宏大蓝图的一部分。一家大型石油公司也加入进来，带来了一场现代救援。

cues.en: People came on buses, busloads of people to spend the day
cues.zh: 人们坐着巴士来，一车又一车的人来这里度过一天

cues.en: and buy the lots.
cues.zh: 并买下地块。

cues.en: Free little tours of the place and the little bus... They had little buses and golf carts.
cues.zh: 提供这里的免费小游览和小型巴士……他们有小巴士和高尔夫球车。

cues.en: Gave them a little spiel on the bus and then took them to the yacht club and had a marina there and
cues.zh: 在车上给他们做个简短介绍，然后带他们去游艇俱乐部，那里有个码头，

cues.en: had a nice lunch at the at the yacht club.
cues.zh: 还在游艇俱乐部吃了一顿丰盛的午餐。

cues.en: The yacht club was a beautiful place, had good food,
